crossRefs.note: “But go your way until the end; for you will rest, and will stand in your inheritance at the end of the days.”
But you, Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book, even to the time of the end. Many will run back and forth, and…
“The vision of the evenings and mornings which has been told is true; but seal up the vision, for it belongs to many…
Wrap up the covenant. Seal the law among my disciples.
All vision has become to you like the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one who is educated, saying…
When the seven thunders sounded, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from the sky saying, “Seal up the things…

people.name: Daniel
people.line: Prophet in Babylon, known for wisdom and visions

translations.web: He said, “Go your way, Daniel; for the words are shut up and sealed until the time of the end.
translations.bsb: “Go on your way, Daniel,” he replied, “for the words are closed up and sealed until the time of the end.
translations.kjv: And he said, Go thy way, Daniel: for the words are closed up and sealed till the time of the end.
translations.asv: And he said, Go thy way, Daniel; for the words are shut up and sealed till the time of the end.
